name: Sharptalon's Claw
summary: Ashenvale's trails grow safer when Sharptalon's Claw is taken from the forest. Bring the trophy to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post to prove Sharptalon has fallen and protect Horde supply lines.

sections.title: A Scourge of the Forest Trails
sections.body: Sharptalon hunts the paths to Splintertree Post as the Horde seeks resources in Ashenvale. The aggressive hippogryph strikes peons and couriers traveling between forward logging camps and the outpost. Its attacks hinder Horde work in the region, where night elven sentinels and dangerous wildlife both threaten the newcomers.

sections.title: Proof of the Hunt
sections.body: Senani Thunderheart, a tauren huntress, directs Horde hunters against Ashenvale's deadliest predators. Sharptalon's talon proves the hippogryph has fallen. Bring the trophy to Splintertree Post, where the outpost's defenders honor the hunt and frightened laborers can walk the woods with less fear.

aliases: what kind of beast is sharptalon
faq.answer: Sharptalon is a fierce, predatory hippogryph that hunts in Ashenvale. It ambushes travelers moving through the forest.

faq.q: Why does Senani Thunderheart want the claw?
faq.answer: Senani Thunderheart wants the claw as proof that Sharptalon, a predator threatening Horde workers and supply routes, has been killed.

faq.q: Where do I turn in Sharptalon's Claw?
faq.answer: Bring the claw to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post in eastern Ashenvale.

faq.q: How does killing Sharptalon help the Horde?
faq.answer: Sharptalon attacks peons traveling between remote lumber mills and Splintertree Post. Killing it makes travel safer for supplies, lumber, and messengers.

faq.q: Is this quest part of a larger chain?
faq.answer: Yes. It belongs to The Ashenvale Hunt, Senani Thunderheart's series of beast hunts, which ends with The Hunt Completed.
Senani Thunderheart is a tauren huntress at Splintertree Post. She watches the forest's balance and tests Horde hunters against Ashenvale's most dangerous creatures.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you help secure trails for Warsong lumber operations and protect peons traveling between forward outposts and Splintertree Post.
As a hunter, you test your tracking and marksmanship against Sharptalon, a feared flying predator beneath Ashenvale's thick canopy.
As a tauren, you follow Senani Thunderheart's hunt and test yourself against nature's fiercest beasts, as tauren tradition demands.
As an orc, you ease the Warsong clan's hard work gathering wood by removing an aerial threat from the forest.
